# Deadbolt

> A local-first, decentralized password manager written in Rust. Your devices hold the vault and sync directly with each other over iroh, end-to-end encrypted, with no accounts and no servers.

Status: alpha (dev builds ship on every push to `dev`).

## Pages

- [Home](https://deadbolt.pw/): Overview, install commands, CLI examples, and trade-offs.
- [Architecture](https://deadbolt.pw/architecture/): Interactive walkthrough of device keys, signed per-device logs, peer-to-peer sync over iroh, pairing, and device removal.
- [Agent skill & CLI reference](https://deadbolt.pw/skill.md): Non-interactive agent usage, flags, environment variables, exit codes, `deadbolt://` secret references, and full CLI reference.
- [Install script](https://deadbolt.pw/install): Shell installer for macOS and Linux (x64 and arm64; glibc and static musl).

## Components

- **CLI & daemon (`deadbolt`):** Local vault management, background sync daemon, secret injection (`deadbolt run`, `deadbolt inject`, `deadbolt read`), one-time peer-to-peer sharing (`deadbolt send` / `deadbolt receive`), and self-updating (`deadbolt update`).
- **Desktop app (`Deadbolt.app` / `deadbolt app`):** Native desktop UI, its own program (`deadbolt-ui`) beside the headless `deadbolt` (macOS universal app bundle and Linux desktop build).
- **Browser extension (Chromium MV3):** Fills and saves through the local app/CLI over native messaging.

## Install (dev channel)

```sh
curl -fsSL https://deadbolt.pw/install | DEADBOLT_CHANNEL=dev sh
```

Or via bun or npm:

```sh
bun add -g @deadbolt/cli@dev
npm i -g @deadbolt/cli@dev
```
